source_notes: The OU publishes R52's Stage 3 module list directly on its qualification page (open.ac.uk/courses/qualifications/r52); Stage 1/2 module codes were independently confirmed live via each module's own page (open.ac.uk/courses/modules/<code>) or its live description page (css2.open.ac.uk/outis/Descs/Courses/<code>.htm), which also states each module's current scheduled presentation date. Two plausible older codes (B291, B292) were checked and confirmed withdrawn, not used. Stage tests and the cumulative exam are original problems in the style of UK intermediate/degree accounting and finance assessment. Numerical answers were computed with Python and checked for internal consistency.
